newsitem.title: USA: Midland gets loan from American Financial.
newsitem.headline: Midland gets loan from American Financial.

text.p: Midland Financial Group Inc said on Friday that it has reached an agreement in principle to obtain a new five-year term loan for $20 million.
The loan from American Financial Group Inc of Cincinnati, Ohio would be used with available cash to fully repay a $21.5 million bank line of credit, Midland said.

Under the agreement in principle, Midland said, it will issue to American Financial warrants to buy up to 2.105 million shares of its common stock at $9.50 per share. Midland said the warrants would represent about a 28 percent ownership interest of its outstanding common if exercised in full.
Midland has about 5.5 million common shares outstanding.
The company mainly underwrites and markets private auto insurance through about 8,500 agents in 20 states.
